statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-24137 is a path traversal in the legacy TUF client at pkg/tuf/client.go, which joins a cache base directory with an attacker-controllable target name from signed TUF metadata without validating that the result stays inside the base directory. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/sigstore code directly (sigstore is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not invoke the legacy TUF client, so the cache-write path is never executed.
